mapper.select: SELECT ca_id, ca_name FROM g5_shop_category WHERE ca_id NOT IN ('10', '1010') ORDER BY ca_id
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fm_order ASC) AS row_num, fm_id, fm_subject, fm_order FROM g5_faq_master
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wr_datetime DESC) AS row_num, wr_id, wr_subject, wr_hit, wr_datetime FROM g5_write_tl_notice LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}

SELECT g5wtn.wr_id, g5wtn.wr_subject, g5wtn.wr_content, g5wtn.wr_datetime, g5wtn.wr_link1, g5wtn.wr_link2, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'f1Name', f1.bf_source, 'f1FileUrl', f1.bf_fileurl, 'f2Name', f2.bf_source, 'f2FileUrl', f2.bf_fileurl ) ) AS postFileList FROM g5_write_tl_notice g5wtn LEFT JOIN g5_board_file f1 ON g5wtn.wr_id = f1.wr_id AND f1.bo_table = 'tl_notice' LEFT JOIN g5_board_file f2 ON g5wtn.wr_id = f2.wr_id AND f2.bo_table = 'tl_notice' WHERE g5wtn.wr_id = #{wrId}

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bn_order ASC) AS row_num, bn_id, bn_alt, bn_url, bn_pc_file_url, bn_mobile_file_url, bn_begin_time, bn_end_time, bn_order FROM g5_shop_banner WHERE active_fl = 1

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gsi.it_order ASC) AS row_num, gsi.it_id, gsi.it_name, gsi.it_cust_price, gsi.it_price, gsi.it_img1, gsi.it_type1 AS hit_fl, gsi.it_type2 AS recommend_fl, gsi.it_type3 AS new_fl, gsi.it_type4 AS best_fl, (gsi.it_cust_price - gsi.it_price) / gsi.it_cust_price * 100 AS discount_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsi.it_id AND del_fl = 0) AS review_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(is_score), 0) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsi.it_id AND del_fl = 0) AS review_score FROM g5_shop_item gsi WHERE it_type1 = 1 AND it_use = 1 LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gsi.it_order ASC) AS row_num, gsi.it_id, gsi.it_name, gsi.it_cust_price, gsi.it_price, gsi.it_img1, gsi.it_type1 AS hit_fl, gsi.it_type2 AS recommend_fl, gsi.it_type3 AS new_fl, gsi.it_type4 AS best_fl, (gsi.it_cust_price - gsi.it_price) / gsi.it_cust_price * 100 AS discount_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsi.it_id AND del_fl = 0) AS review_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(is_score), 0) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsi.it_id AND del_fl = 0) AS review_score FROM g5_shop_item gsi WHERE it_type3 = 1 AND it_use = 1 LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gsiu.is_time DESC) AS row_num, gsiu.it_id, gsi.it_name, gsiu.is_subject, gsiu.is_content, gsi.it_img1, gsiu.is_name, gsiu.is_score FROM g5_shop_item_use gsiu INNER JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsi.it_id = gsiu.it_id WHERE gsi.it_use = 1 AND gsiu.del_fl = 0 LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}
